description:
Build a correctly signed JamiDev webhook delivery for testing a handler locally — no real event needed.

Args:
  - type: 'order.created' | 'order.completed' | 'benefit.granted' | 'checkout.session.expired' | 'withdrawal.paid' | 'withdrawal.failed' | 'subscription.created' | 'subscription.renewed' | 'subscription.payment_failed' | 'subscription.updated' | 'subscription.canceled'.
  - secret: signing secret (defaults to JAMI_WEBHOOK_SECRET; any string works for a local test).
  - data: optional fields to merge over the realistic sample payload.
  - livemode: default false (sandbox).
  - target_url: optional. When set, the delivery is POSTed there (e.g. "http://localhost:3000/webhooks/jami") and the response status is reported.

Returns: { payload, signature, headers, curl } — the exact body and X-JamiDev-Signature to send, plus delivery_status when target_url is set. Handlers must verify the RAW body and reply 2xx within 10 seconds.
name: jami_create_test_webhook
title: Create test webhook
